unified_features.name: Personal library
unified_features.rationale: Only Shelfie has a library view; Readr's books table has no feature of its own. One Book entity serves ratings, export and lists.
unified_features.behaviour: A signed-in user adds, lists, edits and deletes books (title required, author optional) in their own library; nobody else sees them.
unified_features.improvements: Shelfie only lists one shared library and nothing creates books: add create, edit, delete and per-user ownership.

unified_features.name: Star ratings
unified_features.rationale: Shelfie (M02) and Readr (M03, dropped) both rate 1-5 stars by appending rows; Shelfie's version is the more complete (HTTP endpoint plus DB CHECK), so it is the one built.
unified_features.behaviour: A user sets, changes or clears a 1-5 star rating on a book in their own library; there is one current rating per user per book.
unified_features.improvements: Upsert instead of append; integer 1-5 enforced in the API and by a DB CHECK; writes committed; 404 for a book that is not the caller's. Scale is 1-5 as both codebases do; Shelfie's documented 1-10 'score' is stale and not followed.

unified_features.name: Library export
unified_features.rationale: Only Shelfie exports. Its code exports JSON; the CSV export in its README and spec was never built.
unified_features.behaviour: A user downloads their own library as JSON: one object per book with id, title, author and current stars (null if unrated).
unified_features.improvements: Scope to the caller; one row per book instead of one per rating; include id and author. CSV is not built (documented only); listed as an open question.

unified_features.name: Reading lists
unified_features.rationale: Only Readr has lists; they hold books from the shared library entity.
unified_features.behaviour: A user creates, renames and deletes named reading lists, views a list's books, and adds or removes books from their own library; a book appears at most once per list.
unified_features.improvements: Readr only had add_to_list: add create, rename, delete, read and remove; unique (list, book); ownership checks on both list and book; writes committed.
